name: pagination
title: Pagination
description: Moves between pages of a long list or table.

examples.name: pagination-demo
examples.title: Pagination
examples.description: Previous, next, boundary pages and siblings around the current page.

examples.name: pagination-compact
examples.title: Compact
examples.description: "Page 3 of 12" between previous and next, for tight spaces.

examples.name: pagination-siblings
examples.title: More siblings
examples.description: siblingCount={2} shows two pages either side of the current one.

props.name: onPageChange
props.description: Called with the new page. Not called for the current page or past either end.

props.name: siblingCount
props.description: Pages shown each side of the current page.

props.name: boundaryCount
props.description: Pages always shown at the start and end.

props.name: variant
props.description: compact shows "Page 3 of 12" instead of page buttons.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name. Landmarks must be unique on a page: with more than one pagination, name each for what it pages ("Search results pages").

props.name: landmark
props.description: Render as a <nav> landmark. false renders a labelled group, for paging that belongs to a component (DataTablePagination defaults to false).

props.name: previousLabel
props.description: Previous button text; stays its accessible name when the text is hidden.

props.name: nextLabel
props.description: Next button text; stays its accessible name when the text is hidden.

props.name: pageLabel
props.description: Word used in page button names ("Page 3") and the compact summary.

props.name: ofLabel
props.description: Word used in the compact summary ("Page 3 of 12").

props.name: isDisabled
props.description: Disables every button, e.g. while a page loads.

keyboard.action: Moves between previous, page and next buttons.

notes: Renders <nav aria-label="Pagination"> around a list of buttons (a labelled group with landmark={false}). Give each instance a unique label when a page has more than one.
The current page has aria-current="page" and an outline, not only a colour change.
Page buttons are named "Page 3"; ellipses are hidden from assistive technology.
At the first or last page, previous/next keep focus and are marked aria-disabled instead of being removed from the tab order.
The compact summary is a polite live region, so page changes are announced.
Responds to its own width: labels hide below 520px and page buttons collapse to "Page 3 of 12" below 400px. Chevrons mirror in right-to-left layouts.

do: Pair with a result count ("Showing 1–10 of 48") — DataTablePagination does this for tables.
Keep the page size stable while people page.
Reset to page 1 when filters change.
Give each pagination on a page its own label, e.g. "Search results pages".
dont: Don't paginate lists short enough to show in full.
Don't use for infinite feeds — load more on scroll instead.
Don't hide the current page number.
